LAB8

2025-03-17

BankChurners <- read.csv("BankChurners.csv")
bank_og <- data.frame(BankChurners[,-1])
bank <- model.matrix(Attrition_Flag~., data = bank_og)[,-1]
bank <- scale(bank)
str(bank)
##  num [1:10127, 1:32] -0.165 0.334 0.583 -0.789 -0.789 ...
##  - attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
##   ..$ : chr [1:10127] "1" "2" "3" "4" ...
##   ..$ : chr [1:32] "Customer_Age" "GenderM" "Dependent_count" "Education_LevelDoctorate" ...
##  - attr(*, "scaled:center")= Named num [1:32] 46.326 0.4709 2.3462 0.0445 0.3089 ...
##   ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:32] "Customer_Age" "GenderM" "Dependent_count" "Education_LevelDoctorate" ...
##  - attr(*, "scaled:scale")= Named num [1:32] 8.017 0.499 1.299 0.206 0.462 ...
##   ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:32] "Customer_Age" "GenderM" "Dependent_count" "Education_LevelDoctorate" ...
k_mean <- kmeans(bank,2,nstart = 100)
k_check <- 1:10
for (i in 1:7){
  k_mean <- kmeans(bank,i,nstart = 50)
  k_check[i] = k_mean$tot.withinss
}
## Warning: Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 506350)
par(mfrow = c(1,1))
plot(k_check, type = "l")

k_use <- 8

k_mean <- kmeans(bank,8,nstart = 100)

pca <- prcomp(bank,scale = TRUE)
pc_var <- (pca$sdev)^2
var_ratio <- pc_var/sum(pc_var)
var_cumu <- cumsum(var_ratio)

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
plot(var_cumu)

pc_select <- head(which(var_cumu > 0.8),1)

plot(pca$x[,1:pc_select],col = k_mean$cluster+1, pch=20, cex=1,ann = FALSE,xaxt='n',yaxt='n')

sum(k_mean$cluster == 1)

## [1] 686
bank_complete =hclust(dist(bank), method="complete")
bank_average =hclust(dist(bank), method="average")
bank_single =hclust(dist(bank), method="single")

par(mfrow=c(1,3))
plot(bank_complete ,main="Complete Linkage", xlab="", sub="", cex=.9)
plot(bank_average ,main="Average Linkage", xlab="", sub="", cex=.9)
plot(bank_single ,main="Single Linkage", xlab="", sub="", cex=.9)
